provider.description: Provider token owning this event; MUST equal reference.provider.

workTrigger.description: Set by the adapter from its label config: the issue carries a Work-triggering label. The kernel reads the flag, it never interprets labels.

text.description: Issue/comment body excerpt feeding Work input (for action=commented).

headRef.description: Adapter-normalized head ref of the conversation's branch context, when the provider exposes one. The kernel MUST prefer this over digging into `payload`.

labels.description: Adapter-normalized label names on the issue (providers shape labels differently; normalization is the adapter's job). The kernel MUST prefer these over digging into `payload`.

payload.description: Verbatim provider event payload as received by the adapter.
